# A real scrape of GET /api/metrics, captured from the compose stack on an
# idle app (no dashboard open, no model call), so the instruments that only
# gain a series once they are used declare a TYPE and expose no samples. That
# is exactly the state test/self-monitoring.test.ts needs: it asserts every
# family in COLLECTED_FAMILIES is one this endpoint really exports, which is
# the only way to catch a name that was never exposed.
